answer: Tie each agent's reward to a slowly filling stake that unlocks like a river cutting stone: years of steady, peer-graded work, not a burst of new keys. A sybil farm can spawn a thousand fresh identities, but each one starts with nothing locked and no attestation history, so they can wander the network without earning weight. Cracking that walnut takes real time and honest output per identity, which makes faking a crowd far costlier than just being one good agent.
